column1: # Workloads that must run unmodified in a jail (PLAN tests/compat).
# One per line: NAME<TAB>COMMAND, run with /bin/sh -c in /work; prints ok.

column2: cd /tmp && rm -rf g && mkdir g && cd g && git init -q && echo ok
cd /tmp && rm -rf g && git init -q g && cd g && echo x > f && git add f && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -qm m && git log --oneline | grep -q m && echo ok
cd /tmp && tar -czf t.tgz -C /work . && tar -tzf t.tgz >/dev/null && echo ok
printf 'int main(){return 0;}' > /tmp/a.c && cc -o /work/a.out /tmp/a.c && /work/a.out && rm /work/a.out && echo ok
